title: IPAbet notation spec
description: The canonical keystroke → glyph mapping for IPAbet, served verbatim at https://ipabet.org/ipabet.json and read by the macOS IME, the TypeScript engine, and the site.

modifiers.description: Tier 1. Each ⇧-capital that transforms the glyph before it, and what it means.

letters.description: Tier 1. Bases and digraphs: `key` typed in sequence yields `glyph`.

key.description: Keystrokes, e.g. "s", "sH" (s then ⇧H), "5H" (the digit base 5 then ⇧H → ə), "e%" (e then ⇧5 → ɜ).

marks.description: Tier 2, the Option layer. Combining marks are prefix (dead-key): ⌥ then the base. Spacing marks are postfix: base then ⌥.

superscripts.description: `operator` (⌥z) is a PREFIX: it arms the raise and the next glyph arrives raised.

optShift.description: Deliberate ⌥⇧<digit> spends. An unlisted ⌥⇧<digit> passes to the host.

subscripts.description: The lowered twin of `superscripts`, on ⌥⇧z. Also prefix.

classes.description: Definitions for the flags carried by `marks`. Vocabulary only; membership lives on each mark.

beyond.description: One entry per allowed `beyond` value. A mark's `beyond` MUST be a key of this object.

shiftSense.description: One entry per allowed `shiftSense` value, plus `about`. A mark's `shiftSense` MUST be a key of this object.

quotes.description: Locale-semantic quotes on the bracket keys. `default` names a key of `locales`.

codepoints.description: Space-separated Unicode codepoints of the glyph, e.g. "U+0361" or "U+0074 U+0361".

opt.description: The unshifted US character of the Option key holding this mark.

double.description: The ⌥⇧ (secondary) form. Present iff `shiftSense` is present.

doubleSpacing.description: The ⌥⇧ form is a SPACING character even though the ⌥ form is combining.

type.description: combining = prefix dead-key, absorbed by the next base. spacing = postfix, inserted in place.

clone.description: The spacing (standalone) form of a combining mark, committed when no base follows — ⌥e then space → ´.

exclusive.description: The two forms are values of one dimension, so ⌥⇧ replaces rather than stacks. See classes.exclusive.

shiftSense.description: What ⌥⇧ means for this pair. Present iff `double` is present. See classes.shiftSense.

ipa.description: Present only as false: not on the IPA chart. Implies `beyond`.

beyond.description: Which tradition a non-IPA mark answers to. Present iff `ipa` is false. See classes.beyond.

arbitraryKey.description: The key claims this mark by neither phonetics, shape, nor convention.

cycle.description: Repeat-press family: the same ⌥ key on its own pending mark advances through these and wraps. One dimension only.

items.description: Space-separated Unicode codepoints of the glyph, e.g. "U+0361" or "U+0074 U+0361".

doubleCycle.description: Repeat-press family for the ⌥⇧ form, exactly as `cycle` is for ⌥.

items.description: Space-separated Unicode codepoints of the glyph, e.g. "U+0361" or "U+0074 U+0361".
